name: Performance, presence and capacity monitoring
summary: How Track3D watches its own platform: web page performance (real-user monitoring with Slack alerts), online presence, and the Project 10K capacity dashboard for executives, engineering and TechOps.

roles.note: None of these services checks who is calling. The intended audiences are Track3D staff (DEC-074).

requirements.title: Key pages are monitored for performance, with thresholds and alerts
requirements.statement: Track3D measures load performance (first contentful paint, largest contentful paint, time to interactive) on chosen pages, shows it in dashboards, and alerts when a page regresses past a threshold. The PRD proposes Google PageSpeed Insights.
requirements.rationale: The code measures real users instead (OPS-REQ-013). The choice of method and targets is open in DEC-075.

requirements.title: Real-user monitoring alerts on slow pages
requirements.statement: Today web apps on track3d.ai domains send page vitals and API timings to a monitoring service, which keeps hashed IP and browser details rather than raw values. Every two minutes it compares each page's 75th percentile over the last ten minutes with thresholds, and posts to Slack when a page with enough sessions (200, or 100 for viewer pages) is over.

acceptance_criteria.given: 250 sessions on a project page in ten minutes with a 75th-percentile LCP of 4.5 seconds
acceptance_criteria.then: A Slack alert names the page and its p75

acceptance_criteria.given: A viewer page with a 75th-percentile LCP of 5 seconds
acceptance_criteria.then: No alert is raised, because viewer pages use a 6-second threshold

requirements.title: The capacity dashboard reports the one-hour goal
requirements.statement: The capacity dashboard shows how many eligible captures reached a registered, quality-checked, correctly scaled point cloud within 60 minutes of cloud upload validation, against an 80% goal, with P50, P70, P80 and P90 durations. Captures at 45 to 60 minutes are shown as at risk, and later ones as breached. Failures and retries stay in the count; exclusions need a recorded reason.

acceptance_criteria.given: 100 eligible captures validated in the selected period, 78 of which reached the verified point cloud within 60 minutes
acceptance_criteria.then: It shows 78% attainment against the 80% goal, and the P50, P70, P80 and P90 durations

acceptance_criteria.given: A capture 50 minutes after validation with no verified point cloud
acceptance_criteria.then: The capture is listed as at risk
